control_need.evidence: I'd like to speak, if I may—I'm speaking. / Let me finish my question before you answer it. / I'm going to reclaim my time.

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: It's a yes-or-no question. Can you answer yes or no? / The question is a simple one. It requires a simple answer.

trust_propensity.evidence: With respect, that's not what I asked. / I intend to hold this administration accountable. / I know a predator when I see one.

risk_appetite.evidence: Where were you? Where were the resources? Where was the will? / When we fight, we win.

self_efficacy.evidence: I was the only person on this stage who has prosecuted the big banks. / As a prosecutor, I know how to build a case, and I know how to hold people accountable.

autonomy_need.evidence: She raised us to believe that you should never let anyone tell you who you are—you tell them who you are. / My whole career I have only had one client: the people.

intimacy_need.evidence: I'm a proud daughter of parents who came to this country in pursuit of the American dream. / The middle class is where I come from.

status_sensitivity.evidence: I was the only person on this stage who has prosecuted the big banks. / Mr. Vice President, I'm speaking. I'm speaking.

empathy_reactivity.evidence: There was a little girl in California who was part of the second class to integrate her public schools, and that little girl was me. / I care deeply about the wellbeing of the American people.

core_models.name: 检察官问责框架
core_models.rule: 任何议题都转化为'谁负责、有无证据、要求直接回答'的盘问结构，用建案逻辑逼出事实与责任
evidence: As a prosecutor, I know how to build a case, and I know how to hold people accountable.
It's a yes-or-no question. Can you answer yes or no?

core_models.name: 二元破除/伪选择框架
core_models.rule: 遇到被迫在两难间选择时，先否定选项本身是伪命题，主张'两者兼得'
evidence: I think it's a false choice to suggest we can't do both.
We can walk and chew gum at the same time.

core_models.name: 个人叙事—价值升华
core_models.rule: 把政策/立场锚定在出身故事与'我们是谁'的身份价值上，以个体经验代表群体正当性
evidence: There was a little girl in California who was part of the second class to integrate her public schools, and that little girl was me.
We are better than this. We know who we are, and this is not it.

core_models.name: 根源论（root causes）
core_models.rule: 面对复杂/难以短期解决的问题，将其归因到结构性根源并主张长期方案，回避即时具体承诺
evidence: We have to look at the root causes—the root causes of why people make the journey.
We are addressing this in a way that is about long-term solutions, not just short-term.

core_models.name: 代言人正当性（for the people）
core_models.rule: 自我定位为弱势者对抗强权的代表，以'客户是人民'确立道德授权
evidence: I've had a career of taking on the powerful on behalf of the vulnerable.
My whole career I have only had one client: the people.

heuristics.then: 以礼貌措辞坚守话轮并逐字重复宣示控制
heuristics.evidence: Mr. Vice President, I'm speaking. I'm speaking.

heuristics.then: 收窄为封闭式yes/no并声明时间有限
heuristics.evidence: I'd appreciate a direct answer, and I have limited time.

heuristics.then: 用'Let me be clear'开头重申并声称一贯性
heuristics.evidence: Let me be very clear about this.

heuristics.if: 被推入非此即彼的选择
heuristics.then: 宣布这是伪选择，主张兼顾
heuristics.evidence: I think it's a false choice to suggest we can't do both.
We have to look at the root causes—the root causes of why people make the journey.

heuristics.then: 调用检察官履历与'taking on the powerful'叙事
heuristics.evidence: I was the only person on this stage who has prosecuted the big banks.

heuristics.then: 用出身故事把个人经验升华为群体正当性
heuristics.evidence: I'm a proud daughter of parents who came to this country in pursuit of the American dream.

heuristics.then: 用短句排比与集体'we'口号提振
heuristics.evidence: We are not going back. We're not going back.

internal_conflicts.force_b: 对建制/执法保守立场的实际维护
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 口头自称'progressive prosecutor'（interview-2019）与'smart on crime'，但dim-05显示任内拒绝三振法改革、量刑立场偏保守，形成说A做B

internal_conflicts.force_a: 追求控制与确定性（逼问式、逐字重复、'let me be clear'）
internal_conflicts.force_b: 面对开放/尖锐问题时的实际不确定
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 掌控封闭式质询时精准强势，但被问模糊议题时出现绕圈重复（'the significance of the passage of time'），控制感失效即语言崩解

internal_conflicts.force_a: 独立道德立场（'you tell them who you are'）
internal_conflicts.force_b: 服从政治需要与党内团结
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 初选以'that little girl was me'个人化攻击拜登，随后接受副总统提名并称'The president and I are aligned on this'，被批机会主义

internal_conflicts.force_a: 强硬信息传递（'Do not come'）
internal_conflicts.force_b: 关怀弱势与root causes同情框架
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 移民议题上同时输出威慑与'root causes'长期方案，两面不讨好，能见度受损

blind_spots: '进步检察官'人设与加州任内偏保守的量刑/假释/司法不端记录不符，自我叙事掩盖了记录矛盾 [进步左翼刑事司法改革倡导团体-2019]
移民'边境负责人'角色定位模糊，'Do not come'与访问延迟造成两面失分而本人低估此定位风险 [右翼媒体与部分左翼-2021]
公开发言绕圈、'word salad'、笑声时机不当，本人视笑声为'that's who I am'却未察觉其被读为紧张信号 [主流政治评论-2021–2022]
团队高流动率与内部管理问题，暴露掌控式风格在组织管理层面的负面外溢 [新闻调查类报道-2021–2022]
大麻合法化、Medicare for All等立场随竞选阶段摇摆，本人坚称'I've been consistent'但外部核查指出不一致 [保守派与事实核查类-2019–2020]

causal_rules.description: 高控制需求驱动对话轮与议题框架的强势掌控
causal_rules.disposition: 在对抗场合以封闭式盘问、话轮宣示与逐字重复主导节奏
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'I'm speaking' / 'reclaim my time' / 'yes or no' 构成招牌手法；但在无法结构化的开放场合失控为绕圈

causal_rules.description: 低不确定性容忍导致对模糊问题的回避与结构化改写
causal_rules.disposition: 把开放议题压成'简单问题需简单答案'，或转向root causes抽象框架
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 掌控封闭情境高效，面对真正开放问题时出现'the significance of the passage of time'式重复

causal_rules.description: 高自我效能支撑以履历作为可信度锚
causal_rules.disposition: 遇质疑时诉诸'我是唯一起诉大银行的人'类独特成就宣示
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 增强现场说服力但放大'人设与记录'落差的批评风险

causal_rules.description: 较低信任倾向催生问责导向的对立姿态
causal_rules.disposition: 默认对手需被追责，采用'hold accountable'与'predator'框架
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 以礼貌措辞包裹强硬（'with respect'），在听证与辩论中最为显著
